description: Check values that another reader - a model reading the page image, an extraction API - returned from this document, without reading in its place. Each value is claimed under the label of its row and gets one of three answers. confirmed: a row that label names prints the figure. contradicted: the rows that label names print other figures, and every one of them was read with confidence. not-found: neither - this reading cannot vouch for the value and does not say it is wrong, so check it by eye. A contradiction is only pronounced from cells read surely, which is why a doubtful row answers not-found. A value sent without a label can only be found somewhere on the page, a much smaller claim. What this cannot see is the column: a figure confirmed on its row may still be last year's.

digest.description: The digest read_table returned for this file. When given, the call is refused if the file has changed since: its rows would no longer be the ones numbered.

maximumPages.description: How many pages to open. Defaults to 40, which bounds a runaway read rather than describing your document: raise it for an annual report.

path.description: Absolute path to the file on this machine. It is read here and never uploaded.

values.description: The values the other reader returned.

label.description: The words that name its row, as the other reader read them.

page.description: The page it was read from.

value.description: The value. A JSON number is a figure; a string is a figure when it holds a digit and no letter, and words otherwise.

written.description: The decimal mark the claimed strings are written with, when it is not the document's: a model asked for JSON writes 1234.5 for a page printing 1 234,5.

name: verify_values

reason.description: Why the file did not open, when the library could tell: empty, too-big, no-text, too-slow, or the kind of bytes it was. Only on an unreadable verdict.

title: Check what another reader says the document prints
